subject: histology

Sparse peripheral myofibrils and abundant glycogen in the subendocardium
Lipid droplets and mesothelial junctions in the myocardium

A gap junction within an intercalated disc

No gap junctions between neighboring cells
Large T tubules near Z discs and dyad formation
Multiple peripheral nuclei beneath the sarcolemma

Intercalated discs prevent fibroblast migration
Cardiac muscle lacks a capillary network

Backflow prevention by venous valves
Helical contraction of medial smooth muscle
Elastic recoil of the tunica media

P-selectin in Weibel-Palade bodies
Collagen I in caveolae

Net contraction with increased vascular resistance
Conversion into fibroblasts without a tone change
Loss of all calcium responsiveness

Loss of angiopoietin signaling with preserved VEGF-driven sprouting

The artery lacks an adventitia
